_comment: Emergency protocols. Steps with source_ids come from the DGLRM/ESAM-SMG CPR-in-microgravity guideline. Steps without source_ids are PLACEHOLDER: the guideline does not detail them. The guideline gives no microgravity compression rate/depth, so no timers are set.

protocols.title: Crewmate collapsed / chest pain
trigger: PLACEHOLDER: symptom that triggers this protocol.

steps.text: PLACEHOLDER: check whether the crewmate responds and is breathing.
steps.detail: PLACEHOLDER: recognition steps are not detailed in the cited guideline.

steps.text: PLACEHOLDER: alert the crew and ground control.
steps.detail: PLACEHOLDER: call-for-help steps are not detailed in the cited guideline.

steps.text: Start chest compressions with the Evetts-Russomano method. No restraint is needed for initial basic life support.
steps.detail: The rescuer hooks one leg over the patient's shoulder and the other around the patient's torso, interlocks the ankles at the patient's back, and compresses the chest.

steps.text: If the Evetts-Russomano method is inadequate, switch to the reverse bear hug method.
When possible, restrain the patient on the Crew Medical Restraint System.
steps.detail: Use the handstand method if the dimensions allow it; otherwise use a restrained standard or straddling position.

steps.text: Use a defibrillator only when the patient is restrained to an electrically isolated, safe surface.
steps.detail: Use an AED with voice prompts. Start CPR even if no defibrillator is available.

steps.text: Manage the airway only with at least 2 rescuers and the patient restrained.
